task.title: Define CodeWiki hot-state retention cleanup
task.summary: Separate dogfood hot state from package source cleanup, document trace hot/cold retention and compatibility vocabulary, and purge only eligible artifacts through GC with restore evidence.

goal.outcome: Dogfood and local state retention rules are clear for lifecycle traces, trace catalog, generated graph/cache, runtime state, scratch paths, and compatibility vocabulary.
acceptance: Docs/file-structure map distinguish package source from `.codewiki/**` dogfood truth, hot traces, cold trace catalog, generated views/cache, runtime/session scratch, legacy build/gate evidence, `.pi`, `.vscode`, and `.tmp-worktrees`.
Hot/cold telemetry retention states when a trace remains as full JSON and when it may be cataloged and cold-archived through Git restore refs.
`.tmp-worktrees` remains ignored or is removed only after dirty/claim checks prove safe; no production semantics depend on it.
Post-close GC dry-run identifies eligible tracked/runtime artifacts; any purge writes restore ledger with archive commit/tree proof or records deferral/block reason.
No gate/build evidence required for open/current policy is deleted.
Lexicon linter either passes for `proof`/`checks`/`build`/`validation` compatibility terms or records explicit deletion-triggered deferrals.
non_goals: Do not implement the lifecycle trace writer itself if TASK-093 has not landed.
Do not purge `.codewiki/validation/**` or `.codewiki/builds/**` evidence needed by active migration tasks.
Do not remove local scratch folders without Git/worktree/lease safety checks.
verification: wiki_gc dry-run with archive refs when purge is requested

delta.desired: Retention docs and tests distinguish current truth, hot trace truth, cold trace catalog, runtime coordination, generated cache, local scratch, and compatibility vocabulary with safe deletion triggers.
delta.current: User sees `.codewiki/**`, legacy build/gate roots, `.tmp-worktrees`, `.pi`, `.vscode`, generated/runtime paths, and compatibility vocabulary as stale/deprecated because production semantics are unclear after trace-primary decisions.
delta.closure: Task closes with retention docs, lexicon cleanup/deferral evidence, and GC dry-run/purge evidence without unsafe deletion.
